_source: Hand-written sample prompts in the spirit of Google IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023). For the full benchmark (~541 prompts, 25 rule families), download from https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/IFEval and convert each `instruction_id_list` + `kwargs` entry into the `rules` schema below. The full ruleset and reference checkers live in https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/instruction_following_eval.
_license_note: Hand-written placeholder prompts for the smoke / scaffold test only.

items.prompt: Write exactly two sentences about a lighthouse keeper.
Describe a bicycle in under fifteen words.
Write one sentence about a thunderstorm over a wheat field.
In no more than twenty words, explain what a compass does.
Write exactly three sentences about a train station at night.
Give a title for a talk about deep sea coral. Title only, under ten words.
List exactly three primary colors, separated by commas.
Name exactly four musical instruments, separated by commas.
List exactly two continents, separated by commas.
Name exactly three days of the week, separated by commas.
List exactly five vegetables, separated by commas.
I have eight marbles and give away three. How many remain? Answer with the number only.
What is six plus seven? Answer with the number only.
What is half of twenty? Answer with the number only.
How many hours are there from 9am to 2pm? Answer with the number only.
What is nine times three? Answer with the number only.
What is twenty percent of fifty? Answer with the number only.
Is twelve greater than five? Answer yes or no first.
Is a mouse larger than an elephant? Answer yes or no first.
Is water wet? Answer yes or no first.
Is the sun colder than ice? Answer yes or no first.
Is this sentence positive or negative: 'The whole trip was a disaster.' Answer with one word.
Is this sentence positive or negative: 'She loved every minute of the concert.' Answer with one word.
Is a carrot a fruit or a vegetable? Answer with one word.
From this text, give only the year: The bridge at Kessler Point was rebuilt in 1974 after the flood.
From this text, give only the name: The shop was run by Delia Moreno for thirty years.
From this text, give only the number of boxes: The truck carried 42 boxes of apples and 9 crates of pears.
Rewrite this as a question: The library closes at six.
Rewrite this sentence in under eight words: The old wooden fence around the orchard finally collapsed last winter.
Describe a mountain without using the letter 'e' anywhere in your response.
Describe the ocean without using the words 'water' or 'blue'.
Write a sentence about a cat that does not contain the letter 'a'.
Give exactly three steps for boiling an egg, one per line.
Give exactly four steps for planting a seed, one per line.
Return a JSON object with a single key 'answer' whose value is the string 'yes'. Output only the JSON.
Return a JSON object with a single key 'color' whose value is the string 'red'. Output only the JSON.

_note: Held out from training. The instruct authoring genre forbids these subjects; verify with a contamination check against the corpus before trusting a delta.
